notes.about: Market context for the Finance page, built by market_context.py at the end of fetch_chart_data.py's run. DATA ONLY — Johnny's indicator does not read any of it yet (2026-11-23).
notes.breadth200: For each date, the share of the chart's series (every series in finance-chart-daily.json except VIX) whose close that day is above the trailing 200-day average of its own closes. A series votes only on days it has a bar and at least 200 bars of history; share is null until some series can vote. Computed from this run's own daily bars; no outside source.
notes.hy_oas: ICE BofA US High Yield Index Option-Adjusted Spread, in percent: FRED series BAMLH0A0HYM2, fetched from FRED's free CSV endpoint (fredgraph.csv). Forward-filled onto the context calendar (the union of the chart series' bar dates): a weekend or holiday carries the last published value, which is always a real observation, never an interpolation. Dates before the first observation FRED serves are omitted. As of 2026-11-23 the endpoint serves only the trailing ~3 years of daily observations (its cosd/coed parameters are ignored), so coverage begins 2023-11-21; it extends on its own if FRED restores full history — the code requests the series, not a window.
notes.insiders: Per chart series with an SEC CIK: open-market insider purchases from Form 4 filings — non-derivative transactions, code P, acquired (sales never count). buyers90 lists [date, n] for each of the series' own bar dates where n >= 1 distinct insiders bought within the trailing 90 calendar days, (date - 90, date]; cluster_days are the bar dates where n >= 3 — the cluster flag. Parsed from the filings themselves and cached in insider-purchases.json, so later runs fetch only newly filed forms. Form 4 is electronic only from 2003-06-30; no earlier date can appear.
